subject: Seedling: Eval harness onboarding and rollout guardrails
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Brody <tom@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Seedling: Eval harness onboarding and rollout guardrails

Tom / Maya —

Thanks again for the kickoff today. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the proposed approach for wiring Acme's prompt sets into the Redwood eval harness and the Canary/Rollback guardrails we recommend for the initial 3-week rollout. I attached the first-pass prompt set and a checklist PDF for the integration.

High-level plan (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (now): exchange prompt set CSV + access to sample traffic and schema.
- Week 1: integrate prompt sets into eval harness, generate baseline metrics, tag high-risk prompts.
- Week 2: run staged canary (1% -> 5% -> 20%) with live telemetry and regression alerts enabled.
- Week 3: expand to full traffic if no regressions or execute rollback plan.

Key guardrails we will enable:
- Regression alert thresholds (F1 drop > 6% OR human-review failure rate > 3%).
- Canary steps with automated rollback trigger (detailed in seedling-canary-matrix.xlsx).
- Prefix/KV cache monitoring to detect latency regressions.

Action items for Acme: share sample payloads + a short list of 20 golden prompts to seed the eval harness (I attached a CSV). Also confirm the S3 bucket or temp share link for test inputs.

Marissa, Lauren, Karthik: can you confirm the alert targets (PagerDuty/Slack) and the expected owners for the canary windows?

Thanks —
Sean
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_promptset_v1.csv, eval_harness_integration_checklist.pdf
From: Tom Brody <tom@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seedling: Eval harness onboarding and rollout guardrails

Sean —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick questions:
1) For the regression alert thresholds, are those hard stops or advisory? Our compliance team will want to understand the rollback cadence.
2) Who owns the manual approval at the 5% -> 20% step?
3) We can share sample payloads; will upload a folder to the Drive link you provided.

We also need to ensure the canary doesn't trigger downstream billing spikes — can you confirm estimated token usage at each step?

On first pass this looks good. Maya and I will upload the 20 golden prompts by end of day.

—Tom
Director, Product Integrations
Acme Health

Subject: Re: Seedling: Eval harness onboarding and rollout guardrails

Tom —

Short answers:
- Thresholds: the F1 / human-review thresholds are configured as automatic triggers for an investigation, NOT an immediate full rollback at the 1% canary step. We require a human confirmation at the 5% -> 20% jump unless an egregious failure mode is detected (e.g., hallucination rates > 7% on safety prompts).
- Owners: Redwood CS (me) will run day-to-day canary monitoring; product/eng (Karthik & Lauren) will sign off on 5% -> 20% progression. We'll coordinate the manual approval inside Slack, and the eval harness will put a hold if automated conditions breach.
- Token usage: estimate attached in the checklist (short summary: ~8k tokens/day at 1%, ~65k at 20%). We'll provide a precise cost estimate after we see baseline token length distribution from your sample payloads.

Next steps I need from Acme: Drive link with sample payloads, and a point-of-contact for compliance for the SOC2 audit artifacts (if they request runtime logs).

I'll start mapping the prompt tags in the attached CSV and add a column for "risk_level."

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seedling: Eval harness onboarding and rollout guardrails

Tom / team —

Couple of clarifications from the implementation side:
- Canary automation: our plan is to automate metric collection and alerting. We will not auto-rollback from 1% unless the system detects a catastrophic safety signal. All other regressions will generate a P1 Slack alert and open an internal incident with an automated triage note.
- Rollback procedure: if human reviewers confirm regression at 5% or 20%, we will perform a staged rollback to the last verified model variant (typically 2 hours to revert routing and invalidate caches). We'll also run a scoped replay on a cloned pool to validate before reintroducing traffic.
- Eval harness integration: we will ingest your 20 golden prompts and map them to evaluation metrics (accuracy, safety, response-time percentiles). Can you confirm which Slack channel Acme wants the alerts in (and PD schedule)?

Karthik and I will own the deployment steps; Marissa will run verification and collect human review feedback.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference

I've attached the final checklist and canary matrix. Please reply-all with any changes to the PD schedule or alert channel. If I don't hear back, we'll plan the Week 1 integration for next Monday.
